description: CloudFormation CloudTrail with log file validation off, single-region, no KMS
note: CIS AWS 3.1, 3.2 and 3.7. The one case here where all three tools agree rule for rule on all three defects -- log file validation, single-region, and logs not encrypted with a CMK -- which is what a three-source language is supposed to look like. The trail's own S3 bucket raises the bare-bucket set again (AWS-0086 through AWS-0132, CKV_AWS_18/21/53-56); unlabelled here because cfn-s3-unencrypted owns it.
